sources.document_title: LM74700-Q1 Low IQ Reverse Battery Protection Ideal Diode Controller
sources.locator: Table 5-1 Pin Functions DBV page 3; 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings and 6.5 Electrical Characteristics tables page 4-5
sources.evidence_extract: LM74700-Q1 SOT-23-6 (DBV): 1 VCAP charge pump; 2 GND; 3 EN; 4 CATHODE (external NFET drain); 5 GATE; 6 ANODE (NFET source, input). Abs max ANODE to GND -65..65 V; EN to GND -0.3..65 V for V(ANODE) > 0. EC TJ -40..125 C: V(ANODE) operating 4..60 V (3.2 V start per features); V(AK REG) 13/20/29 mV; V(AK) full conduction 34/50/57 mV; V(AK REV) reverse-current threshold -17/-11/-2 mV.
